description: In the Virtualmin control panel (accessible at https://localhost:10000, login: root / GymAnything123!), create a new MySQL database for the virtual server 'brightstar.test'. The database name should be 'brightstar_shop' (Virtualmin may automatically prefix it with the account name, e.g., 'brightstar_shop' or 'brightstar_brightstar_shop' — use whatever name Virtualmin suggests that ends with 'shop'). Navigate to the brightstar.test virtual server in the left panel, then go to 'Edit Databases' or 'MySQL Databases' and create the new database.

metadata.description: Create a MySQL database with 'shop' in the name for brightstar.test
